text_block_list.name: Young Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Father, wait right there! I'll zoom over
really fast! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I loved running. I think... I probably
always did.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Even then, I knew it wasn't forever. The
only course I'd ever run was a
little path
through a walled-off garden. The only goal
I'd ever cross
was the line of clovers at the
edge.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (And that was enough for me. I wasn't un happy.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The challenge of your dreams... Go all
out... for your moment in the
spotlight."
Oh, wow! Everything looks so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"All at the Japan Umamusume Training
Center Academy!" ...I wish I
could go!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (This is ... what I wanted.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Y-you surprised me. Um, can I help
you? You look rather scary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll bet. I've had a long, hard think about
Fine's situation—about her
responsibilities
to the people she serves—and my own
responsibilities
to those I teach.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How I feel about them? As in... what you
asked before? Whether I'm
satisfied with
the experience I'm getting?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, I think... I already said I am.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, of course! It's
just that... my life is on a
completely
different track from the other Umamusume
here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My duty is to bring peace and prosperity
to the land that welcomed
my house. That
is my calling, my pride, and why I am here,

broadening my horizons.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Does that make sense? I wasn't raised to
be a runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a gentle smile plastered across her
face, but her words don't
match it. I'm not
giving up yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I already knew about her royal lineage and the duties she bears. I understand that her studies suit her station, but they don't suit her!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My... dreams?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Fine Motion goes quiet, and I
let her be. I think... maybe
she just needs a
chance to be herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And to that end...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What? You want me to race Fine for
"practice"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Your memory's worse than your grandma's
PC. I'm not repeating
myself again. Piss off
with the lukewarm goody-two-shoes act!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Oh yeah?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I must ask that you give Her
Highness's safety due
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh, they've got you marked.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
At risk of sounding rude, I think you fail to
see the gravity of your
proposal. You are
knowingly exposing a dignitary to danger.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: If anything happened to her, you would lose everything.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
...No, you do not "understand"! As captain
of her security, I must do
all in my power
to prote—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch... Shut up, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Now. First things first—when's the
scrimmage?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Captain... You're sure? You'll really let me
run? Practice or not, it's
still a race.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
The trainer is willing to bet their livelihood
to help you pursue your
goals. With
respect for that conviction, and for your
wishes...

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
...And as someone who has been by your
side for this long, I will not
oppose your
decision. Please, do as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: HEY! Are we running or aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This is your chance. Don't give me your
"I'm happy just watching"
crap, got it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The stands and the track are different
worlds, princess. Don't think
you
understand our passion—our
obsession—just 'cause you watched a

couple races.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So follow me, Fine. And stop playing
dumb. I know you want it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine accepts Shakur's challenge, and the
two take off running!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Wow... I can feel each step reverberate
through my legs. The scenery
vanishes
behind me. My heartbeat is deafening.
And I'm... I'm really
running!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah! C'mon, is that all you got, princess?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Shakur! The way she's pressuring me... it's
giving me chills! If I don't
hurry, she'll
leave me behind! But... but! Somehow—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I... can still... I can still go faster! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, that's more like it! But I'm not
letting you off easy! Hraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... I can't believe it. My heart is
throbbing. My soul is
screaming—go faster!
Go further! Run, run, RUN!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I... I want to run too!

text_block_list.name: Fine & Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh. Looks like I'm faster.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe... You win. Oh, I'm so frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! ...Thank you. I truly appreaciate
the opportunity to confront
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And... I believe I owe you an apology. I
wasn't entirely honest about
my thoughts
before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I... don't want to go home yet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay here and run more and more
and more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is brimming with pride and
confidence, brighter than
ever.
